name: audio_transcribe
description: Transcribe audio files to text using OpenAI Whisper (local or API).

manual.overview: Use when you need to convert speech in audio/video files to text—meetings, podcasts, voice memos. Works offline with local Whisper for privacy-sensitive content.

examples.description: Transcribe Spanish podcast with higher accuracy model

tips: Provide language hint when known—speeds up processing and improves accuracy
Use 'base' for quick drafts; 'medium' or 'large' for final transcripts
Ensure audio is reasonably clear; noisy recordings may produce garbled output
edge_cases: Very long files can hit timeout; consider splitting or trimming first
Binary/corrupt files will fail with cryptic errors
